paragraphs: Quantcast’s real‑time ad optimisation demands models that adapt instantly; I’ve built an LLM agent that resolves gene aliases, explains scoring methods and tracks dataset provenance for a multi‑omics cancer platform, proving my ability to engineer responsive AI tools.

I crafted scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM, BiRNN and CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker—showing my skill in turning complex ML workflows into production‑ready APIs.
